name: cc-primitives
description: Claude Code v2.1.327 primitives that UltraCode Goal composes, from the official docs: /goal, Auto Mode, permission modes and permission rules, Auto Memory, PreToolUse and Stop hooks in settings.local.json, skills, subagents, dynamic workflows, headless claude -p and the CLI flags, and what a script driving claude -p sessions unattended needs: session ids and resume, the result and usage JSON, usage limits and retries, prompt-cache TTLs, PreToolUse defer, worktrees and background sessions. Use when wiring a BMAD module into Claude Code through hooks, settings, permission rules, skills, subagents or headless runs, when driving claude -p sessions from a script, or when checking how one of these primitives behaves. Not for BMAD skill workflows (see bmad-method-bmm).
